subject: Daos
text: Daos has no elemental weakness.

evidence.quote:
BOSS TIME: Daos
WEAKNESS: None

subject: Alekia
text: The recommended level for Alekia is 1.

evidence.quote:
ALEKIA [ALEK1]
Recommended Level: 1

subject: Alekia
text: A Dress can be found by examining the bookshelf upstairs in Roman's inn.

evidence.quote: Return to Roman's inn and head upstairs.  Examine the bookshelf where you will find a DRESS (sell).

subject: Hero
text: A Dagger can be purchased for the Hero at the weapon shop for 50 gold.

evidence.quote: Dagger   50 (buy for Hero)...Go up to the weapon shop where you should buy a Dagger for the hero.

subject: Alekia
text: A Potion is located in a bookshelf between the weapon and item shops.

evidence.quote: In between the weapon and item shops is a bookshelf which contains a POTION.

subject: Alekia
text: A Revive is found in the bookshelf of the house to the far left.

evidence.quote: Walk back to the intersection by the flower field, climb the steps, and enter the house to the far left.  Examine the bookshelf to find a REVIVE, and take steps through a secret passage to a chest which contains SWEET WATER.

subject: Alekia
text: A chest reached through a secret passage in the house to the far left contains Sweet Water.

evidence.quote: Walk back to the intersection by the flower field, climb the steps, and enter the house to the far left.  Examine the bookshelf to find a REVIVE, and take steps through a secret passage to a chest which contains SWEET WATER.

subject: Alekia
text: A Power Potion is hidden in the flowers to the left of the house across the north bridge.

evidence.quote: Hidden in the flowers to the left of the house is a POWER POTION.

subject: Alekia
text: A Cloth Helm is inside the bookshelf of the house across the north bridge.

evidence.quote: Inside the house, examine the bookshelf which contains a CLOTH HELM (equip on Hero).

subject: Alekia Castle
text: A Revive is located in the bookshelf of the upper left room on the first floor of Alekia Castle.

evidence.quote: Pass up the stairs and walk to the upper left room where you can find a REVIVE in the bookshelf and an ARROW in the chest.

subject: Alekia Castle
text: An Arrow is found inside a chest in the upper left room on the first floor of Alekia Castle.

evidence.quote: Pass up the stairs and walk to the upper left room where you can find a REVIVE in the bookshelf and an ARROW in the chest.

subject: Alekia Castle
text: Bookshelves in the room to the right on the first floor contain a Swing Wing and Escape.

evidence.quote: In the room to the right, examine the bookshelves to find a SWING WING and ESCAPE.

subject: Alekia Castle
text: A Potion is inside the dresser in the upper left room on the second floor.

evidence.quote: In the upper left room, examine the dresser which contains a POTION.

subject: Alekia Castle
text: Another Potion is located in the bookshelf in the right room on the second floor.

evidence.quote: Check out the bookshelf in the room to the right to find another POTION.

subject: Princess Estea
text: Talking to Princess Estea rewards the player with 100 Gold.

evidence.quote: Talk to Princess Estea to receive 100 GOLD for your journey.

subject: Alekia Castle
text: A Stuffed Bear and Bracelet are found in the upper left room on the third floor.

evidence.quote: Head to the upper left room to find a STUFFED BEAR and BRACELET (save for later).

subject: Alekia Castle
text: Three chests in the first floor treasure room contain Sweet Water, an Antidote, and a Revive.

evidence.quote: Outside the room, walk around to the upper right steps, which you can take to a treasure room on the first floor, with three chests which contain a SWEET WATER, ANTIDOTE, and REVIVE.

subject: Chatam
text: The recommended level for Chatam is 1.

evidence.quote:
CHATAM [CHAT1]
Recommended Level: 1

subject: Chatam
text: A hidden Mind Potion can be found below the lower left tree in Chatam.

evidence.quote: Check out the lower left tree.  Below it, you can find a hidden MIND POTION.

subject: Chatam
text: A hidden Great Potion can be found in the middle of the left field in Chatam.

evidence.quote: In the middle of the left field, you can also find a hidden GREAT POTION (save for later).

subject: Chatam
text: Examining the bookshelf in the upper right house reveals a Smoke Ball.

evidence.quote:
Finally, in the upper right house, examine the 
bookshelf which contains a SMOKE BALL.

subject: Cave to Sheran
text: The recommended level for Cave to Sheran is 2.

evidence.quote:
CAVE TO SHERAN [CTSH1]
Recommended Level: 2

subject: Cave to Sheran
text: Two chests along the straightforward path in the eastern cave contain 200 Gold and a Potion.

evidence.quote: Follow the straight-forward path to a room with two chests which contain 200 GOLD and a POTION.

subject: Cave to Sheran
text: A hidden Revive is located at the very end of the upper dead-end path.

evidence.quote: First, take the upper path to a seemingly useless dead end.  Walk all the way to the end to find a hidden REVIVE.

subject: Sheran
text: The recommended level for Sheran is 3.

evidence.quote:
SHERAN [SHER1]
Recommended Level: 3

subject: Sheran Castle
text: Opening the four chests in the left room yields 4 Potions.

evidence.quote: In the left room, open the four chests which contain 4 POTIONS.

subject: Sheran Castle
text: Four chests in the right room contain Sweet Water, Antidote, Foul Water, and Awaken.

evidence.quote: In the right room, open the four chests which contain a SWEET WATER, ANTIDOTE, FOUL WATER, and AWAKEN.

subject: Sheran Castle
text: Bookshelves in the left room on the second floor contain Sweet Water and Foul Water.

evidence.quote:
Examine the bookshelves in the left room which contain a SWEET WATER and
FOUL WATER.

subject: Sheran Castle
text: Three chests and a dresser in the second floor right room contain 2 Arrow, a Mid Arrow, and a Revive.

evidence.quote:
Go to the right room, then open the three chests and dresser which
contain 2 ARROW (not to be confused with arrowS), a MID ARROW (save for later),
and REVIVE.

subject: Lufia
text: Attempting to leave Alekia causes Lufia to join the party.

evidence.quote: Attempt to leave the village and Lufia will join.

subject: Cave to Sheran
text: Talking to the person found in the cave gives the player the Sheran Key.

evidence.quote:
Along the way back to Sheran, you will find someone in the cave.  Talk to him
to receive the SHERAN KEY.

subject: Sheran Castle
text: Opening the right door in the throne room reveals a chest containing 100 Gold.

evidence.quote:
Open the right door to find a chest which contains
100 GOLD.

subject: Sheran Castle
text: Flipping the wall switch in the left room of the throne area reveals the steps down to the dungeon.

evidence.quote: In the left room, flip the switch on the wall there...The switch you flipped earlier will have revealed the steps to the right to the dungeon level which you could not access before.

subject: Sheran Castle
text: A Great Potion is found inside the bookshelf in the dungeon of Sheran Castle.

evidence.quote: Examine the bookshelf inside which contains a GREAT POTION (save for later).

text: The battle against ????? cannot be won, resulting in the player's defeat and warping back to Alekia.

evidence.quote: ******************************************************************************* BOSS TIME: ????? WEAKNESS: HA! STRATEGY: None. You have no way to win this battle. The game might as well have just said, "Go home." ******************************************************************************* Fortunately, you manage to survive and are warped back to Alekia.

subject: Lilah
text: Lilah joins you in Alekia Castle so you can escort her back to Danil in Chatam.

evidence.quote: Talk to Lilah in the middle room so she will join you.  Then, escort her back to Chatam.

subject: Chatam
text: Talking to the old man in the field in Chatam rewards the player with a Speed Potion.

evidence.quote:
Afterwards, talk to the old man in the field to receive a
SPEED POTION (save for later) from him.

subject: Treck
text: The recommended level for Treck is 5.

evidence.quote:
TRECK [TREK1]
Recommended Level: 5

subject: Treck
text: A Hair Band can be found in the bookshelf of the first house to the left in Treck.

evidence.quote:
In
the first house to the left, examine the bookshelf which contains a HAIR BAND
(equip on Lufia).

subject: Treck
text: A chest upstairs in the first house on the left contains a Dress.

evidence.quote: Upstairs, open the chest which contains a DRESS (sell).

subject: Treck
text: A Power Gourd can be found near the equipment shops in Treck.

evidence.quote:
Head down to the equipment shops where you can find a POWER GOURD (boosts ATP
in battle, save for later) and make recommended purchases listed above.

subject: Treck
text: Two chests reached via the left path in the secret port passage contain Arrows and a Smoke Ball.

evidence.quote:
On the southern end of town is the port.  Go into the secret passage and take
the left path to two chests which contain the ARROWS and SMOKE BALL.

subject: Treck
text: An Escape and Swing Wing are hidden by the boxes in the pub basement.

evidence.quote:
Return to the intersection and head up to the basement of the pub.  To the left,
by the boxes are an ESCAPE and SWING WING that are hidden there.

subject: East Cave
text: The recommended level for East Cave is 5.

evidence.quote:
EAST CAVE [ESTC1]
Recommended Level: 5

subject: East Cave
text: A chest found after descending two rope ladders contains Cloth Shoes.

evidence.quote:
Follow the path down two rope ladders, and open the chest which contains the
CLOTH SHOES (equip on Lufia).

subject: East Cave
text: A chest on the other side of the door opened by Ainea contains a Swing Wing.

evidence.quote:
Climb down the next rope ladder and Ainea will open the door for you.  On the
other side, open the chest which contains a SWING WING.

subject: Guy's House
text: The recommended level for Guy's House is 5.

evidence.quote:
GUY'S HOUSE [GUYS1]
Recommended Level: 5

subject: Guy's House
text: Examining the tombstone outside Guy's House reveals a Short Sword.

evidence.quote:
Examine the tombstone to find a
SHORT SWORD (equip on Hero).

subject: Guy's House
text: A Great Potion is found inside the bookshelf inside Guy's House.

evidence.quote:
Afterwards, in the house, examine the bookshelf which contains a
GREAT POTION (save for later).
